notes: MINE FIRST, GUESS SECOND was followed. The literal sweep is the headline NEGATIVE result: all 99 mined hp_ literals were already known, so the string-table oracle for this dialect is exhausted -- do not re-run it. All 405 new bones came from GRAMMAR + STRUCTURE, at a combined expected-false of 0.41. Zero of the 97 side-tokened hits contradicted the side law (noise would contradict ~half). The single most reliable technique was the parent-derived rule (rule.state / rule.propattach): because the child prefix is dictated by its parent name, the pool collapses to a suffix vocabulary of 4 and expected-false drops to ~0.02. Prefer parent-derived and mirror rules over any dictionary sweep. 11 names are flagged confidence=low: they have no series or side-law witness and should be treated as hypotheses, not facts.
